description: This Java class 'VoiceRecognitionTrigger' manages the initiation of voice recognition in an Android input method, selecting between different trigger mechanisms (ImeTrigger or IntentApiTrigger) based on their availability.

classes.name: VoiceRecognitionTrigger
classes.description: A class that manages voice recognition triggers, choosing between IME and intent-based triggers, and providing methods to start voice recognition and check trigger status.

methods.name: VoiceRecognitionTrigger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the trigger based on the provided InputMethodService.

methods.name: getTrigger
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate Trigger instance based on availability.

methods.name: getIntentTrigger
methods.description: Initializes and returns the IntentApiTrigger if available.

methods.name: getImeTrigger
methods.description: Initializes and returns the ImeTrigger if available.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if a trigger is installed.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating the trigger is enabled.

methods.name: getKind
methods.description: Returns a string indicating which trigger(s) are active ('both', 'ime', 'intent', or 'none').

methods.name: startVoiceRecognition
methods.description: Starts voice recognition with the specified language if a trigger is available.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Refreshes the trigger when the input view starts.
